name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension of Singletons plus Empty Set
proof: Singletons plus the empty set has established VC and Littlestone dimension one. The surveyed sandwich theorem therefore forces Prefix-k Littlestone Dimension to equal one for every fixed k.
references: Derived from Proposition \ref{prop:prefix-littlestone-order} in the survey and the established benchmark values
